name: ShadowNet controlled-lab PCAP corpus
split_policy: Entire capture sessions stay in exactly one partition; devices and attack runs must not cross partitions.

scenarios.name: Normal interactive traffic
scenarios.description: Web, DNS, SSH administration and ordinary file transfer.

scenarios.name: Normal high-volume traffic
scenarios.description: Approved downloads, backups and concurrent application use.

scenarios.name: Service discovery
scenarios.description: Authorized scanning inside the isolated lab.

scenarios.name: Authentication pressure
scenarios.description: Controlled failed-login sequences against disposable lab accounts.

scenarios.name: Web traffic stress
scenarios.description: Rate-limited load against a disposable local service.

gates: Run only in an isolated, owned lab with no route to third-party systems.
Record capture SHA-256, device roles and exact scenario start/end timestamps.
Keep benign warm-up before attack onset so early-warning lead time is measurable.
Do not tune on the held-out test captures.
